notes: Column type shorthand: uuid, text, int, bigint, numeric(p,s), bool, date, timestamptz, jsonb, enum:<name>, money (= bigint pesewas). 'pk' primary key, 'fk:<table>' foreign key, 'req' not null, 'uniq' unique, 'default:<v>'.
Every table also has created_at timestamptz req default:now() and updated_at timestamptz req default:now() unless noted. Business tables have deleted_at timestamptz (soft delete).

Tenant tables (tenant: true) carry garage_id uuid req fk:garages and are protected by RLS: a row is visible only if the current user has an active membership in that garage (and branch, where the role is branch-scoped). Platform admin bypasses via service role in admin server code only.
Customer-facing reads (portal, magic links) go through server code that checks customer ownership or the magic-link scope; customers never get direct table access through the anon key.
Implement in Drizzle with one schema file per domain under lib/db/schema/.

Accounts (Nov 2026): ONE Supabase account per person for every role (driver, garage staff, parts seller, broker). A person's roles = their workspaces: garage memberships, vendor_members, broker_members, and a driver workspace when portal_profiles/customers match their verified phone. Phone-only accounts use an internal auth e-mail '<digits>@phone.fixam.app' (never shown) and users.email = null.

columns.phone: text uniq (E.164) — verified via SMS code; the sign-in identifier for phone accounts

columns.deposit_rules: jsonb default:'{}' (per job template or default percent)
columns.reminder_overrides: jsonb default:'{}' (per due_item_type overrides of reminder-rules.json)

columns.name: text req
columns.code: text req (3-5 chars, used in document numbers)

document_sequences.note: Increment with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE inside the issuing transaction

stock_movements.note: Append-only. stock_levels is updated in the same transaction.

columns.garage_id: uuid fk:garages (delivery garage; null when a driver has parts sent home or picks up)
columns.fitting_fee: money req default:0 (driver orders to a garage)

vendor_orders.rls_note: Visible to: members of garage_id, members of vendor_id, the ordering customer, platform admin.

columns.part_id: uuid fk:parts (garage part it maps to)

columns.lines: jsonb req (list of {part_id, quantity, unit_cost, condition})

columns.title: text
columns.effective_due_date: date req (min of due_date and predicted_due_date)

message_log.note: Every outbound message (not just reminders) is logged here and counted against the plan allowance.

columns.balance_due: money req default:0 (generated: total - amount_paid - credits)

invoices.rule: Lines and totals are frozen when status leaves 'draft'.

payment_allocations.note: Lets one payment (e.g. credit account settlement) cover several invoices.

audit_logs.note: Insert-only; no updated_at; no deletes (revoke UPDATE/DELETE in RLS).

brokers.description: Insurance brokers and DVLA agents with their own workspace (/broker).
brokers.rls: RLS enabled with no policies (server-side access only).

broker_requests.description: A renewal job sent to a broker by a driver (portal) or handed off by a garage from one of its renewal_requests.

columns.requester_phone: text req (driver phone, or garage phone)

price_observations.note: Anonymised prices from issued invoices for the fair-quote check. Never exposed per garage; reads aggregate only with >=5 rows from >=3 garages.

columns.amount: bigint pesewas (per unit, or per hour for labour)

vehicle_passports.note: One public passport per plate (plate_search) across garages. Owner (by phone) controls it; regenerating rotates token. Public page never shows owner details or prices.

ai_calls.notes: Metadata only — prompts and transcripts are never stored.

obd_scans.note: garage_id set for garage scans (job), null for driver scans (vehicle). Clears audited in audit_logs (obd.clear_codes.*).

financing_applications.note: Ghana Card number is passed to the lender only, never stored.

columns.ghana_card_verified: bool default:false (number checked by admin; do not log)

ledger_entries.notes: Append-only (trigger blocks UPDATE/DELETE). Accounts: customer_funds, escrow, vendor_payable, garage_payable, fixam_commission, payout_clearing, refund.

seasonal_campaigns.note: One per garage per season per send day; created 7 days ahead (48h review if late).

part_photo_scans.note: Photo itself not stored. Accuracy = chosen_part_type_id = top_part_type_id.

job_side_effects.checked_in: Record odometer reading (required); recalc km_per_day; create tracker magic link; notify customer.
job_side_effects.estimate_sent: Create estimate magic link; send via preferred channels.
job_side_effects.approved: Reserve stock for approved part items; for out-of-stock items, suggest vendor order (job-linked).
job_side_effects.quality_check: Require all required checklist tasks done.
job_side_effects.ready: Require QC sign-off; generate draft invoice from approved items; notify customer with pay link; play job_ready animation.
job_side_effects.delivered: Require invoice issued and (paid OR on credit account OR payment plan); issue stock from reservation; create/refresh due items from job template (e.g. oil change); complete matching due items.

domain_rules.tax_calculation: For each line: base = quantity × unit_price − discount. Apply each enabled tax rule whose applies_to includes the line type. Non-compound taxes use base; compound taxes use base + previous taxes. Round each tax amount half-up to the nearest pesewa per line. If prices_include_tax, back out tax from the price. Rates stored in basis points (bp). Implement in lib/domain/tax.ts with exhaustive unit tests.
domain_rules.stock_valuation: Weighted average by default: on receipt, new_avg = (qty_on_hand × avg + qty_in × unit_cost) / (qty_on_hand + qty_in). FIFO optional (cost layers) — implement weighted average first.
domain_rules.deposits: Deposit payments link to estimate_id; when the invoice is issued, apply them as payment_allocations.
domain_rules.credit_account_balance: balance increases when an invoice is charged to the account and decreases on payment allocation; block charging if balance + invoice.total > credit_limit unless user has credit_accounts.exceed_limit.

who.accept/cancel: the requesting driver, or garage staff (owner|manager|service_advisor) for garage hand-offs

rules: Requester gets an SMS on quote and on every status change; broker gets an SMS on new requests and on accept/cancel (lib/messaging/direct.ts).
A garage renewal can have only one open broker request at a time.
Only brokers with status 'active' appear in pickers; verified first.
Garages can still process renewals themselves — handing off to a broker is optional.
